Komplexe Themen einfach erklären gehört zu deinen Stärken.

Location: Barcelona

About Us

We are Dragons, a global creative agency working with bold brands to build cultural relevance, connection, and long-term impact through strategy-led creativity.
We bridge digital and creative thinking, developing innovative work across skincare, healthcare, fashion, lifestyle, FMCG, and more. Our international teams in the US and Barcelona deliver results through smart strategy, sharp creativity, and meticulous execution.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Creative Director with strong conceptual thinking, great visual taste and experience working across global wellness and lifestyle brands.
Someone who can move comfortably between product and lifestyle, science and culture, and who understands how creative needs to work across the full consumer journey.
You might be working on a product with a complex ingredient or efficacy story one day, developing a talent-led campaign the next, and figuring out how that same brand idea translates into more product-focused or conversion-driven work further down the funnel.
This is a global role, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable developing ideas that can travel across markets and cultures without becoming generic.
You’ll lead creative development across global wellness, beauty-adjacent and lifestyle brands, from early concepts and campaign platforms through to production and execution.
We’re looking for someone who cares about the idea as much as the craft, but also understands what the creative is there to do.
You’ll work hand in hand with Strategy, as well as Copy, Design, Social and Production, to understand the audience, cultural context, role of each channel and each stage of the funnel, and translate that thinking into strong creative.
This isn’t purely an art direction role. You need to be able to come up with strong campaign ideas, build on other people’s ideas and turn them into something bigger.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strong global campaign ideas and creative platforms that can live across markets, channels and executions.
Partner closely with strategists from the beginning of the process, challenging and building on briefs rather than simply receiving them.
Understand the role creative plays across the full funnel, from building awareness and brand desire to communicating product benefits, driving consideration and supporting conversion.
Know when an execution needs to build the brand, when it needs to explain the product and when it simply needs to make someone want it.
Turn strategy, product benefits and consumer insights into simple, relevant creative ideas.
Build global creative platforms that have a clear central idea while leaving enough room for markets to make them culturally relevant.
Lead the visual direction of brands across product, lifestyle, talent and culture-led work.
Find interesting ways to communicate ingredients, efficacy, innovation and science without everything suddenly looking clinical.
Make products feel desirable through photography, film, CGI, design, casting, styling and storytelling.
Bring product and lifestyle together naturally, rather than creating a beautiful lifestyle campaign and remembering the product at the end.
Develop ideas around talent, creators, partnerships and cultural moments that make sense for the brand and the market.
Think beyond traditional campaign formats and identify opportunities across social, experiences, collaborations, entertainment and emerging culture.
Lead work from concept through production, keeping the original idea and level of craft intact along the way.
Present and sell creative thinking to senior clients and stakeholders across different markets.
Lead and develop multidisciplinary and international creative teams.

What we’re looking for

A Creative Director who is conceptually strong and visually sophisticated, with a portfolio that shows range.
Big campaign thinking
Ideas with a clear point of view that can become genuine global platforms, not just a collection of executions.
Strong visual taste
A great eye for photography, film, casting, styling, design and contemporary brand aesthetics.
Product storytelling
Experience making products, ingredients, technology or benefits interesting and desirable, especially when there’s real science or efficacy behind them.
Full-funnel creative thinking
An understanding of how people move from discovering a brand to considering and buying it, and how the creative job changes along the way.
Strong creative + strategy partnership
Someone who likes working closely with strategists, has a point of view on the brief and knows how to turn strategic thinking into creative opportunities.
Global thinking
Experience developing work for multiple markets and understanding the difference between a global idea and simply making the same campaign appear everywhere. You should be comfortable collaborating with local teams and adapting ideas around different cultural behaviors and audiences without losing the core creative thought.
Lifestyle and culture
Work that shows an understanding of how brands can play in culture through talent, creators, collaborations, social, entertainment and experiences.
Range
We want someone who can create a beautiful product or efficacy story and then switch gears into a culturally relevant lifestyle campaign without either feeling forced.

Key Requirements

10+ years of creative experience, ideally across agencies and/or ambitious consumer brands.
Significant experience working on global brands and international campaigns.
Experience leading integrated and full-funnel campaigns, from brand-building through product and conversion-focused creative.
Background in wellness, beauty, personal care, lifestyle, premium CPG or adjacent categories.
Experience working closely with Strategy on audiences, consumer journeys, cultural insights and creative briefs.
Experience working with product claims, ingredients, efficacy or science-led briefs is a plus.
Strong photography and film production experience.
Experience working with talent, creators or culturally driven campaigns.
Experience leading multidisciplinary and international creative teams.
Excellent client-facing and presentation skills.
Native or near-native English, or equivalent professional fluency developed through extensive experience working in English. This person needs to be able to concept, debate, present and sell creative ideas confidently in English with senior global clients and teams.

Portfolio

We want to see ideas, taste and range.
Showcase strong campaigns, as well as activations, social ideas, collaborations and product experiences that demonstrate different ways brands can connect with people.
We want to see work that feels relevant to its audience, where the product matters and the visual execution is strong.

English (mandatory)

A global environment, cutting-edge tools, and a culture driven by trends and innovation.

As the Creative Director at Audible, you will be a critical part of our creative team and overall business. As the creative lead in our UK hub, you will work closely with partners across the company to translate strategic briefs into bold, fresh, culturally resonant creative. You will develop and deliver work across every customer channel and touchpoint, from original content campaigns to product launches and major brand initiatives. You will balance a globally minded vision, aligning with counterparts and peers across markets, with local relevance and nuance. Your leadership will be seen in the mentoring of junior teams, partnership with agencies, and in your own direct creative contributions.

You will lead the creative concepting, development and production of 360-degree campaigns for Audible Originals, Exclusives and third-party titles, including title key art, live action shoots, trailers and print. You are a driven, passionate creative at heart—a leader with the vision to help shape a brand’s evolution and the craft to execute it with excellence. You anticipate production needs and manage workflows to achieve results while ensuring work is delivered on-time and on-budget. You are a hands-on leader who inspires teams and partners to push boundaries, delivering work that is strategically smart, emotionally compelling, and visually exceptional.

Lead by example — mentoring and developing junior creatives, inspiring teams and partners to push boundaries, experiment, and challenge the status quo

jobs.description:
About Us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance
.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Head of Brand, you'll own the creative and brand strategy end-to-end, bridging the gap between high-level storytelling and measurable business impact, ensuring our mission resonates across every touchpoint.

Here's What That Looks Like In Practice

Creative Production - Owning the production of creative assets, ensuring every output meets a consistently high bar of quality, craft, and brand consistency.
Brand Activation - Driving both ATL (TV, radio, OOH, print) and BTL/untraditional activations, bringing the brand to life in bold and memorable ways.
Social Media & Community - Steering our presence across existing Social media channels and new ones, while building an influencer strategy that extends our reach and relevance.
Brand Strategy & Insights - Shaping and safeguarding brand identity, and grounding decisions in research and listening, including surveys with both customers and non-customers.
Leadership & Team Rituals - Building and mentoring the team behind these pillars, establishing clear creative rituals (design reviews, sprints, feedback loops) and tools to ensure efficient, high-quality output.
Cross-functional Collaboration - Partnering closely with Growth and Product teams to align brand initiatives with acquisition goals, retention targets, and product launches.
Performance-Driven Branding - Defining and tracking KPIs for brand awareness and consideration, ensuring that even the most "creative" projects are data-informed and contribute to Satispay's overarching OKRs.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

Who We're Looking For

You'll take on one of the hardest challenges at our scale: defining Satispay's identity globally while ensuring our brand initiatives directly align with acquisition and retention goals — and building the creative team and rituals that stay ahead of it as we grow. We're not looking for a caretaker of an existing setup. We're looking for someone who has built or transformed a function, made hard calls under pressure, and can say "here's the decision, here's why, here's what happened."

10+ years of experience - Proven track record in brand management or creative direction, ideally within fast-growing tech companies or top-tier creative agencies.
Strong Technical & Visual Culture - Deep understanding of design systems, rebranding processes, and multi-channel campaign production (from social media to TV/OOH).
A "Hands-on" Leader - You love to lead by example. You're not just a "manager of resources" but someone who can get into the details of a layout or a script to ensure excellence.
Data-Informed Mindset - Ability to translate brand concepts into business objectives, utilizing KPIs and OKRs to measure impact and iterate quickly.
Exceptional Communicator - Fluent in English, with the ability to simplify complex brand visions for internal stakeholders and external audiences alike.

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.

Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

Own outcomes that reach millions. Lead functions where the results show up directly in the experience of 6.5M+ people and the businesses they pay every day.
Operate in high-growth. You'll make high-stakes calls without waiting for perfect information, in an environment that changes fast as we launch and scale new products.
Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.
Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

About

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.
⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.
🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.
👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

Initial salary:
Starting from €65,000 gross per annum

This baseline is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role's core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent.
The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value.

Equal opportunity employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.

Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Creative Strategist

The Sr. Creative Strategist for UK/EU is a performance-minded, market-savvy leader who bridges global creative output with the nuances of European consumer behaviour. This person excels at identifying what's working in the US market and translating it for UK and German/French audiences; while also building the infrastructure to test, learn and scale independently. This person is energized by solving complex business problems, making high-judgment decisions in ambiguous environments, and turning insights into scalable, revenue-driving creative strategy.

Success in this role looks like:

Consistently identifying high-performing US creative and adapting it to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth in UK & DE/FR markets
Owning the experimentation framework that enables the EU/UK team to move fast, document learnings, and scale winners while maintaining strong alignment with brand identity
Serving as the primary creative liaison between UK & DE/FR market needs and the US creative and production teams
Improving win rates and spend efficiency through a rigorous, data-backed testing cadence
Acting as a strategic partner to the Director of Paid Social UK & DE/FR and cross-functional brand, design, and marketing teams
Leveraging data to inform strategic direction
This role is critical to establishing Paid Social as a core growth engine in the UK, Germany and France.

This role will be onsite 4-days a week based in London, Madrid, or Berlin.

Responsibilities

Creative Adaptation & Briefing

Audit US creative performance regularly to identify high-potential concepts for UK & DE/FR adaptation
Brief the US creative team on market-specific adaptation needs; adjusting copy, tone, cultural references, pricing, and product focus for UK & DE/FR audiences
Commission net-new creative concepts where US assets are insufficient or market-specific angles are required
Write clear, detailed high converting ad briefs for video, static, UGC, and other ad formats with UK & DE/FR market context embedded
Ensure all adapted and net-new creative aligns with brand identity while resonating locally
Provide strategic feedback to designers and execute on feedback from leadership

Experimentation & Performance

Build and own a structured experimentation framework for UK & DE/FR paid social; covering hypothesis formation, test design, documentation, and results reporting
Prioritise and manage a live test pipeline across Meta (and other channels) to continuously improve creative performance
Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; translate findings into clear strategic recommendations
Conduct consumer, competitor, and trend research specific to UK & DE/FR markets to inform creative direction
Identify winning patterns and codify them into repeatable brief templates and creative playbooks

Cross-functional Collaboration

Serve as the EU/UK creative point of contact for the US production and strategy teams
Partner with the Director of Paid Social EU/UK on channel strategy, creative priorities, and growth planning
Collaborate with Brand, Design, and broader Marketing teams to align creative output across channels including affiliate, CRM, and PR

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree required
5+ years of relevant creative and marketing experience
Paid Social and/or Direct Response experience required, with strong Meta expertise
Demonstrated experience working across markets; ideally including UK and/or DACH, with an understanding of how to adapt creative for different audiences
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make confident creative decisions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write compelling briefs and copy across formats
Experience managing creative testing frameworks and reporting on results
Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple briefs, markets, and workstreams simultaneously
Comfortable working across Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)
Fluency in English required; German/French language skills a plus
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Strong collaboration skills across creative and marketing teams

Preferred:

Familiarity with TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, or other paid platforms
Experience briefing and working with UGC creators
Background in DTC, fashion or e-commerce brands

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range: £92,000 GBP - £101,000 GBP

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

jobs.description:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™
and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

As Creative Strategist, you will sit at the intersection of performance marketing and our creative team, translating data into the stories, hooks, and formats that drive Yepoda's paid social growth. Your focus is to turn day-to-day performance metrics into actionable creative direction, keeping design, content, and influencer teams aligned on what's winning and why, while building the testing roadmaps that keep our creative pipeline ahead of platform trends.

Your Tasks

Deliver detailed, actionable creative briefs, direct-response copy, and frame-by-frame storyboards for the design team.
Monitor day-to-day micro-metrics (thumb-stop ratios, 3-second hold rates, CTR) to rapidly diagnose asset performance and propose modular iterations.
Act as the bridge between performance and creative by streamlining the asset request pipeline and managing the feedback loop between media buyers and designers.
Supply the in-house production and influencer teams with data-backed insights, winning hooks, and performance trends to guide their shoots.
Proactively design and build A/B testing roadmaps for new hooks, visual formats, and messaging angles.
Define and map specific creative concepts and angles to targeted consumer personas for both evergreen (BAU) and seasonal campaigns.
Spot native platform trends by maintaining a swipe file of Meta vs. TikTok content and mapping competitor strategies.
Present monthly reviews by synthesizing weekly learnings into macro-level creative presentations for stakeholders.
Own post-click/CRO alignment by auditing and advising on e-commerce landing pages to ensure the post-click experience matches the ad narrative.
Build secondary channel playbooks by adapting winning Meta/TikTok creatives for expansion channels like Pinterest, Snapchat, or Reddit.

Your Profile

4+ years of experience in a creative strategy or content strategy, ideally within a D2C or e-commerce brand and in touch with performance marketing.
Proven experience optimizing paid social creative assets for Meta and/or TikTok, with a strong understanding of how platform algorithms use creative signals to define audience targeting.
Comfortable working with performance data (thumb-stop ratios, hold rates, CTR) to diagnose what's working and translate it into new creative angles, not just report on it.
Experience writing creative briefs, scripts, or storyboards for a design team; visual production skills (e.g. Canva) are a plus but not required.
Strong cross-functional collaborator, comfortable aligning performance marketing, design, content, and influencer teams around a shared creative direction.
Familiarity with workflow and creative analytics tools (e.g. Motion or similar).
Fluent in English; Italian or French language is a plus.

What we offer

Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.
Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.
Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.
Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.
We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.
Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!
Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

Mit Herz, Verstand und einem Faible für alles Digitale kreieren wir begeisternden Content für unsere Nutzer:innen und erzielen so maximale Wertschöpfung für unsere Kunden. Uns ist wichtig, dass du mit deinem Naturell und deinen Ideen unser Team ergänzt. Jeder Content ist einzigartig. Du auch.

Werde Teil unserer Flotte und revolutioniere mit uns das Content Performance Marketing!

Als Teil unseres Studio-Teams erwarten dich die unterschiedlichsten Projekte – mal bei uns im Agentur-eigenen Studio, mal unterwegs im Einsatz. Du begleitest Medienproduktionen von Anfang bis Ende und darüber hinaus
Formatentwicklung und -konzeption: Entwicklung von Kanal- und Video-Konzepten, Treatments
Redaktion: Recherche und Themenplanung entlang von Kanalstrategien, Scripting von Videos inkl. visueller Umsetzung
Produktion: Planung von Drehtagen, Scouting, Casting sowie Booking von Talent, Locations und externer Crew, Leitung von Drehs als Aufnahmeleitung/Regie, Review und Abnahme von Skripten und Videos
Planung, Briefing und interne Abnahme der Postproduktion
Abstimmung mit Kunden, Agenturen und Partnern, Präsentation von Konzepten vor Kunden

Qualifikationen

Das Bringst Du Mit

Du weißt, wie YouTube als Plattform funktioniert und worauf es bei Videos ankommt, damit sie organisch ihr Publikum erreichen
Du hast Erfahrung im Producing und in der Organisation von Video-, optional Audio- oder Fotoproduktionen
Du bist kreativ, konzeptstark und kommunikativ, kannst aber auch strategisch und analytisch arbeiten
Du arbeitest gern im Team und übernimmst Verantwortung für dich und deine Crew
Du behältst den Überblick und einen kühlen Kopf, auch wenn es mal wild zugeht
Du hast ein Gespür für aktuelle Trends und Formate
Bonus: Du kennst dich in YouTube Analytics aus und kannst aus der Performance deiner Produktionen konkrete Ableitungen ziehen statt Fragezeichen
Du bist formulierungsstark, hast ein gutes Sprachgefühl sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse
Du bist bereit, Drehs vor Ort zu begleiten

Als Teil der Ströer Digital Group vereinen wir die Vorteile eines Konzerns mit denen unseres Agenturlebens:

Abwechslungsreiche Kunden, Projekte, Themen und Aufgaben
